Each card analyses one verse of the Valmiki Ramayana, Bala-kanda 1. Sandhi is split back into words, every word is given its grammar, and each form is re-derived with Panini's rules (via vidyut). VERIFIED means the words re-join to the verse exactly. A tick means the word itself was derived by rules; words that are not (आर्ष) are labelled, never forced. Hover or tap a rule number, or a part of the translation.

पदार्थः word by word

धनदेन Dhanadaसमः equalत्यागे abandonmentसत्ये truthधर्मः dharmaइव likeअपरः otherतम् thatएवङ्गुण suchlikeसम्पन्नम् succeedरामम् Rāmaसत्य truthपराक्रमम् prowess

Literal translation

That truth-prowess Rāma, endowed with suchlike, [is] equal to Dhanada in abandonment, like dharma in truth, other.

Readable English by rule from the literal one
